high_level_description: This image captures a close-up view of a beautifully decorated cake placed on a white plate with a floral design. The cake is round and covered in yellow frosting, which is piped in a decorative, swirling pattern around the top edge. The center of the cake features a small mound of yellow frosting, adorned with silver and red sprinkles. A single blue candle is inserted into the top of the cake, standing upright. The cake is set on a dark, reflective surface, possibly a glass table or countertop.
